description: This file defines the TaxRate controller class within the Opencart admin namespace, handling events related to tax rate management such as adding, editing, and deleting tax rates. It interacts with models to add tasks corresponding to these events.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Controller class handling events for tax rate operations within the admin panel, specifically for adding, editing, and deleting tax rates by generating and managing background tasks.

methods.name: addTaxRate
methods.description: Generates a task for displaying tax rate info when a new tax rate is added, based on geo zone ID.

methods.name: editTaxRate
methods.description: Generates tasks when a tax rate is edited, adding info tasks for the old and potentially new geo zone IDs after validation.

methods.name: deleteTaxRate
methods.description: Generates a task to delete the tax rate info when a tax rate is deleted.
